name: Fallen Shock Troop
description: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen’s will.

abilities.name: Minion (12)
abilities.description: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Aura of Doom
abilities.description: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
